name: Nick L.
text: Very responsive and professional. Jesse was great to work with on our dryer repair. I would highly recommend them for any appliance repairs!

name: T. Bartolotta
text: We've worked with Jesse several times over the past two years. He is professional, knowledgeable, polite, and reliable. A pleasure to work with. Highly recommend him!

name: Kathy R.
text: Excellent work done efficiently and timely.

name: Orlando C.
text: Just wanted to say what a great experience I had with your company. Jesse was absolutely fantastic. He handled my repair with professionalism and honesty, which is rare to find these days. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt confident in the work being done.

name: Allen M.
text: Great Job, Jesse provided me with part number I needed to fix my oven and saved me some money.

name: Matt C.
text: Great company. Jesse was amazing. He was very professional and honest with my repairs. He offered a fair price and also offered recommendations for future appliance purchases. I will recommend him to everyone.

name: Clifton B.
text: Jesse was fantastic!! He correctly diagnosed both my dishwasher and refrigerator. Because of my home warranty the dishwasher was replaced and he returned to repair the refrigerator. Thanks Blue Jay, my kitchen is whole again!

name: Ricardo B.
text: Blue Jay dispatched a technician same day and fixed my dryer really quickly and efficiently.

name: Kathryn C.
text: I had an oven that was not coming up to temperature. I called Jessie and he came out the next day to replace the ignitor. He was able to arrive 1 hour before scheduled and that worked perfectly with my availability. He explained everything he was doing and answered all my questions. He was very professional and his fee was affordable.

name: Melissa M.
text: Old Washer. New life. Thanks, Jesse!!!
